scenes.description: El sol de la tarde se filtra entre las copas de los robles antiguos. Thalasso corre por el sendero principal. Xylia aparece desde el extremo opuesto de la gran plaza circular. Se encuentran frente a la fuente de piedra.
La habitación está en penumbra, iluminada por velas y una lámpara de pie. Xylia y Thalasso están sentados en el sofá de terciopelo. Afuera empieza a llover.

dialogues.text: Si es un sueño, no quiero despertar nunca.
Me costó creer que eras tú cuando te vi entre la gente.
No iba a permitir que pasara un día más sin encontrarte. Crucé la frontera al amanecer.
No hay ningún lugar en el mundo al que prefiera ir. Mi viaje termina aquí, Xylia.

assets.name: Thalasso
assets.physical: Mediterranean man in his early 30s, lean athletic build, olive skin, thick wavy raven-black hair chin-length, dense short beard, piercing amber eyes.
assets.clothing: Unbuttoned navy canvas field jacket over charcoal gray t-shirt, slim-fit dark indigo denim jeans, weathered brown leather combat boots, silver band on right ring finger.
assets.backstory: Political refugee who spent months traveling across borders to reunite with his partner.

assets.name: Xylia
assets.physical: Woman of East African descent, late 20s, tall graceful frame, deep bronze skin, shoulder-length micro-braids with small gold clips, large expressive mahogany eyes.
assets.clothing: Flowing floor-length emerald green silk wrap dress with floral brocade pattern, gold strappy leather sandals, delicate gold hoop earrings, thin gold chain with sun pendant.
assets.backstory: Established artist waiting in uncertainty for Thalasso's safety.

assets.name: Parque Central
assets.prompt: Expansive public park with rolling hills of golden-green grass shaded by towering ancient oak trees, paved walking paths, distant city skyline, wrought-iron perimeter fencing.

assets.name: Fuente De Piedra
assets.prompt: Three-tiered circular fountain carved from weathered gray limestone, deep green moss in crevices, four snarling lion heads in oxidized bronze weeping water into a wide lichen-stained pool.

assets.name: Apartamento De Xylia
assets.prompt: 400 sq ft studio with cream plaster walls, dark hardwood floors, ornate Persian rug, deep navy velvet sofa, low oak coffee table, vintage mahogany record player, candles and brass floor lamp casting amber glow.

shots.title: Sunlight in the Park
shots.prompt: Wide view of Parque Central, golden afternoon sunlight filtering through dense leaves of ancient oak trees, grass glows warm emerald, distant cityscape blurred, peaceful serene atmosphere.
shots.audio_description: Soft ambient soundscape of wind rustling leaves and distant muffled city traffic. Birds chirp occasionally.
shots.transition_prompt: Slow cinematic pan from peaceful park into Thalasso's determined run.

shots.title: Thalasso's Determined Run
shots.prompt: Thalasso running down the main path, jacket billowing behind him, face shows intense determination, chest heaving with every breath, dappled shadows and light.
shots.audio_description: Rhythmic sound of heavy breathing mixed with rapid footsteps on gravel.
shots.transition_prompt: Tracking shot follows Thalasso, then cuts to Xylia emerging from the crowd.

shots.title: Xylia Joins the Chase
shots.prompt: From far side of plaza, Xylia emerges from crowd, vibrant emerald dress catches light, expression shifts from shock to joy, sprinting toward Thalasso.
shots.audio_description: Background chatter punctuated by Xylia's sharp intake of breath and light taps of shoes.
shots.transition_prompt: Xylia running across plaza, moving toward Thalasso.

shots.title: The Reunion Spin
shots.prompt: Thalasso and Xylia collide in front of stone fountain. Thalasso lifts Xylia off ground, spinning in circle. Emerald dress flares against gray stone.
shots.audio_description: Splashing water blends with laughter and triumphant breathing, music reaches joyful crescendo.
shots.transition_prompt: Couple spinning, slowing down into intimate close-up embrace.

shots.title: A Shared Moment
shots.prompt: Thalasso sets Xylia down slowly, keeps arms locked around her waist. Xylia reaches up to cradle his face. Eyes glistening with happy tears, inches apart, world soft-focus blur behind them.
shots.audio_description: Music softens to gentle piano. Thalasso whispers about dreaming, Xylia's tender response.
shots.transition_prompt: Intimate close-up into passionate kiss silhouetted against sunset.

shots.title: The Timeless Kiss
shots.prompt: Deep passionate kiss in front of stone fountain, sun setting casting long shadows and golden halo around their silhouette, distant tourists as unidentifiable shapes.
shots.audio_description: Ambient noise fades, swelling romantic score, fountain water rhythmic hypnotic background.

shots.title: Atmosphere of the Apartment
shots.prompt: Dimly lit interior, warm glow of candles and floor lamp casting long shadows, vintage record player spinning vinyl in corner.
shots.audio_description: Soft melancholic jazz melody, faint rhythmic crackle of vinyl.
shots.transition_prompt: Pan across room toward seating area where couple sits.

shots.title: Intimate Moment on the Sofa
shots.prompt: Xylia and Thalasso on plush velvet sofa, Xylia legs tucked close, Thalasso holds steaming tea cup, faces highlighted by flickering candlelight.
shots.audio_description: Jazz continues at lower volume, subtle sound of steam rising from tea cup.
shots.transition_prompt: Medium shot shifts to close-up on Xylia's face.

shots.title: Xylia's Realization
shots.prompt: Close-up on Xylia's face, mix of relief and disbelief, warm lamp light catches reflection in her eyes.
shots.audio_description: Xylia speaks softly about not believing it was him.
shots.transition_prompt: Close-up Xylia shifts to Thalasso's intense face.

shots.title: Thalasso's Promise
shots.prompt: Thalasso looks back with intensity and sincerity, sets tea cup down on low coffee table, reaches toward her, background blurred.
shots.audio_description: Thalasso speaks firmly about crossing the border at dawn.
shots.transition_prompt: Push-in Thalasso, pull back to shared embrace silhouette.

shots.title: The Shared Embrace
shots.prompt: Xylia leans head on Thalasso's shoulder, he wraps protective arm around her, silhouettes against warm lamplight.
shots.audio_description: Rain patters softly against window. Thalasso whispers his journey ends here.
shots.transition_prompt: Zoom out embrace shifts to raindrops on window pane.

shots.title: Rain Against the Glass
shots.prompt: Window pane with rain droplets streaking down, dark city barely visible through glass, warm candlelight reflection inside.
shots.audio_description: Jazz fades, rain intensifies, record player reaches end with soft click.
